allergen_requirements.rule: Per FDA FALCPA regulations, tree nuts used as ingredients (Almonds, Pecans) must be listed in the ingredient declaration or in an explicit 'Contains: Almonds, Pecans' statement. An advisory 'May Contain' alone is insufficient for direct ingredients.

net_quantity_rules.rule: For US packaging under 21 CFR 101.105, net quantity on the Principal Display Panel (PDP) must include dual units: both imperial avoirdupois (e.g. 16.9 oz / 1.05 lb) and metric (480 g). Declaring only metric grams without ounces does not meet US PDP standards.

storage_text: Store in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep packaging closed and eat within a month or by date shown, for best before, see base of pack.
